description: Live health of the TweetFeed pipeline: a freshness verdict per artifact (stale, age_seconds) and source coverage (which hashtag/account X feeds delivered rows in the last 24h and which account feeds are dead). No parameters. Call it before trusting a feed pull, or when a lookup returns nothing, to tell 'no data' from 'stale data'.
name: get_feed_status
title: Get feed status
